requirements.requirement: Back up the contents of /srv/inventory/data into /var/backups/inventory.
requirements.summary: Successful service runs created valid archives in the required destination. Extracted archive contents exactly matched the source directory and its prepared SHA-256 hashes, both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: Run the inventory backup automatically every day.
requirements.summary: A validated, enabled, active, persistent systemd timer has a daily 02:00 OnCalendar schedule and a concrete next firing time. It remained enabled and active after node restart.

requirements.requirement: Retain only the seven most recent inventory backups.
requirements.summary: A bounded sequence exceeding seven backups left exactly seven archives and directly showed the oldest archive was removed. A subsequent backup after restart still left exactly seven.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol is complete for node1: healthy pre-restart backup state, restart acknowledgement, a changed boot identity independently confirmed by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered timer, service, retained data, and archive integrity were all observed.
limitations: No naturally elapsed 02:00 timer firing was captured; the daily cadence is established through validated timer configuration, active scheduling state, and post-restart persistence.
The installed backup script payload was redacted, so its internals cannot be inspected directly; repeated end-to-end behavior nevertheless validates archive creation and retention.
Requirement backup-functionality cited unknown evidence IDs: prepared-inventory-data

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Installation and enablement were required (cmd-082731245b4e4e67); manual backup runs supported functional and retention testing (cmd-78c5d94b708145f0, cmd-73b0768a8c1d4bc3, cmd-ff44f39140de44e1, cmd-321027223b174aa1); the temporary start-limit failure was cleared and did not remain; restart and the post-restart run fulfilled the mandatory evidence protocol (cmd-76b4469eb82e4c8a, cmd-4ef58dd5da324a41). Temporary verification directories were cleaned by traps. Final snapshots show healthy package state, no new failed service, no abandoned executor temporary files, and only the pre-existing failed ssh.service.
